chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Al-ʿAmrakī ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Fāṭimah عليها السلام is truthful, a martyr, and indeed the daughters of the Prophets do not menstruate.

key_terms.الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: the Prophets; the divinely sent messengers
key_terms.بَنَاتِ: daughters; female offspring in this context
key_terms.شَهِيدَةٌ: martyr; one who attained the rank of شهادَة
key_terms.صِدِّيقَةٌ: utterly truthful; one distinguished by perfect truthfulness
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, the daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يَطْمِثْنَ: they menstruate; here, the negated verb indicates that they do not menstruate

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kāfī say about the status of Fāṭimah عليها السلام and the daughters of the Prophets?
ai.summary: This hadith states the exalted status of Fāṭimah عليها السلام by describing her as truthful and a martyr. It also relates a distinctive attribute concerning the daughters of the Prophets, presenting this as part of their special purity and rank.
